decision_rule: Over the probe widths that cleared their own shuffle draws, the largest gap between any two periods, in characters, must be at most 10. Larger rules out a single fixed period. Fewer than two widths clearing leaves the gap undefined.
metric: Largest gap in characters between the wobble periods of any two probe widths that both cleared.
notes: A period drifting by, say, 12 characters would be called not fixed here, even if it were one mechanism plus noise. The 10-character cutoff is the design's own guess and is binding. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
